restriction Equality:
  "∀ x y #i. (Eq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (x = y)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x y #i. (Eq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (x = y)"

restriction Inequality:
  "∀ x y #i. (Neq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (¬(x = y))"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x y #i. (Neq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (¬(x = y))"
  */

restriction Unique:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  */

rule (modulo E) AS_Issue_Tokens:
   [ Fr( ~at ), Fr( ~rt ) ]
  --[
  Tokens_Issued( $Client, $User, ~at, ~rt ),
  RT_Active( $Client, $User, ~rt, '0' ), Unique( <'rt_issue', ~rt> )
  ]->
   [
   Active_RT( $Client, $User, ~rt, '0' ),
   !Grant_Family( $Client, $User, ~rt ), Client_Holds_RT( $Client, ~rt )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Client_Present_RT:
   [ Client_Holds_RT( $Client, rt ) ]
  --[ Client_Presented_RT( $Client, rt ) ]->
   [ Out( <'refresh', $Client, rt> ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) AS_Rotate:
   [
   In( <'refresh', client, rt> ), Active_RT( client, $User, rt, count ),
   Fr( ~new_at ), Fr( ~new_rt )
   ]
  --[
  Token_Rotated( client, $User, rt, ~new_rt, count ),
  RT_Consumed( client, $User, rt ),
  RT_Active( client, $User, ~new_rt, <count, '1'> ),
  Unique( <'rt_rotate', rt> )
  ]->
   [
   Consumed_RT( client, $User, rt ),
   Active_RT( client, $User, ~new_rt, <count, '1'> ),
   Client_Holds_RT( client, ~new_rt )
   ]

  // loop breaker: [1]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) AS_Detect_Replay:
   [ In( <'refresh', client, rt> ), Consumed_RT( client, $User, rt ) ]
  --[
  RT_Replay_Detected( client, $User, rt ), Family_Revoked( client, $User )
  ]->
   [ Revoked_Family( client, $User ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) AS_Cascade_Revoke:
   [
   Revoked_Family( $Client, $User ), Active_RT( $Client, $User, rt, count )
   ]
  --[ RT_Cascade_Revoked( $Client, $User, rt ) ]->
   [ Revoked_Family( $Client, $User ) ]

  // loop breaker: [0]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Client_RT_Leak:
   [ Client_Holds_RT( $Client, rt ) ]
  --[ RT_Leaked( $Client, rt ) ]->
   [ Out( rt ), Client_Holds_RT( $Client, rt ) ]

  // loop breaker: [0]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma rotation_single_use:
  all-traces
  "∀ client user rt new1 new2 c1 c2 #i #j.
    ((Token_Rotated( client, user, rt, new1, c1 ) @ #i) ∧
     (Token_Rotated( client, user, rt, new2, c2 ) @ #j)) ⇒
    (#i = #j)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ client user rt new1 new2 c1 c2 #i #j.
  (Token_Rotated( client, user, rt, new1, c1 ) @ #i) ∧
  (Token_Rotated( client, user, rt, new2, c2 ) @ #j)
 ∧
  ¬(#i = #j)"
*/
by sorry

lemma replay_detection_and_revocation:
  all-traces
  "∀ client user rt #i.
    (RT_Replay_Detected( client, user, rt ) @ #i) ⇒
    ((∃ new_rt count #j.
       (Token_Rotated( client, user, rt, new_rt, count ) @ #j) ∧ (#j < #i)) ∧
     (∃ #k. Family_Revoked( client, user ) @ #k))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ client user rt #i.
  (RT_Replay_Detected( client, user, rt ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ((∀ new_rt count #j.
     (Token_Rotated( client, user, rt, new_rt, count ) @ #j) ⇒ ¬(#j < #i)) ∨
   (∀ #k. (Family_Revoked( client, user ) @ #k) ⇒ ⊥))"
*/
by sorry

lemma rotation_chain_integrity:
  all-traces
  "∀ client user rt count #i.
    (RT_Active( client, user, rt, count ) @ #i) ⇒
    ((∃ at. Tokens_Issued( client, user, at, rt ) @ #i) ∨
     (∃ old_rt old_count.
       Token_Rotated( client, user, old_rt, rt, old_count ) @ #i))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ client user rt count #i.
  (RT_Active( client, user, rt, count ) @ #i)
 ∧
  (∀ at. (Tokens_Issued( client, user, at, rt ) @ #i) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ old_rt old_count.
    (Token_Rotated( client, user, old_rt, rt, old_count ) @ #i) ⇒ ⊥)"
*/
by sorry

lemma cross_client_isolation:
  all-traces
  "∀ c1 c2 user1 user2 at rt new_rt count #i #j.
    ((Tokens_Issued( c1, user1, at, rt ) @ #i) ∧
     (Token_Rotated( c2, user2, rt, new_rt, count ) @ #j)) ⇒
    ((c1 = c2) ∧ (user1 = user2))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ c1 c2 user1 user2 at rt new_rt count #i #j.
  (Tokens_Issued( c1, user1, at, rt ) @ #i) ∧
  (Token_Rotated( c2, user2, rt, new_rt, count ) @ #j)
 ∧
  ((¬(c1 = c2)) ∨ (¬(user1 = user2)))"
*/
by sorry

lemma rotation_count_monotonicity:
  all-traces
  "∀ client user old_rt new_rt count #i.
    (Token_Rotated( client, user, old_rt, new_rt, count ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ #j. RT_Active( client, user, new_rt, <count, '1'> ) @ #j)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ client user old_rt new_rt count #i.

 ∧

*/
by sorry
